event.name: San Francisco 49ers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes, Travis Kelce and Andy Reid have made the Kansas City Chiefs a dynasty.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patrick Mahomes rallies the Chiefs to second straight Super Bowl title, 25-22 over 49ers in overtime
